final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and extracting only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required ISO-8601 format with a 'Z' suffix. For each entry, I extracted the message, the last line of the traceback as the exception (or null if none), and calculated the repeat_count including repeated message lines. I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
